# Fixtures

Compiled L0187 boards (reports removed), from the test programs in
`graffiticode/languages/l0187/crates/core/tests/programs/` of the same names. To refresh after a
compiler change, from `languages/l0187/crates/core`:

```bash
cargo run -q --example fixtures   # writes packages/view/embed/fixtures.json
```

then copy each fixture's `data` (without `report`) here.
